verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (Virtual Mail) has a public REST API and an MCP server, so a sandbox is a fair question for this product. However, its API docs describe only a single static key tied to the production account, and they state the docs contain no sandbox or test-mode text. Nothing in the evidence shows an isolated test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
